ex.bn: তোমাদের সৃষ্টি বেশি কঠিন না আকাশের? তিনি তো সেটা সৃষ্টি করেছেন।

ex.en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
ex.bn: তার ছাদ অনেক উচ্চে তুলেছেন, অতঃপর তাকে ভারসাম্যপূর্ণ করেছেন।

ex.en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

ex.en: And after that He spread the earth.

ex.en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

ex.en: And the mountains He set firmly

ex.en: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

ex.en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
ex.bn: অতঃপর যখন মহাসংকট এসে যাবে।

ex.en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

ex.en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

ex.en: And preferred the life of the world,

ex.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

ex.en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

ex.en: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

ex.en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
ex.bn: এর আলোচনার সাথে তোমার কী সম্পর্ক?

ex.en: To your Lord is its finality.
ex.bn: এ সংক্রান্ত জ্ঞান তোমার প্রতিপালক পর্যন্তই শেষ।

ex.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ex.bn: যারা একে ভয় করে তুমি কেবল তাদের সতর্ককারী।

ex.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
